== Biography ==
Mary, daughter of [[Glasgow-1530|Robert Glasgow]] & [[Jack-2557|Elizabeth Jack]], was born or baptised on 20 March 1790 in Barony, Lanarkshire, Scotland.<ref>"Church of Scotland: Old Parish Registers - Births and Baptisms," database, National Records of Scotland, [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ ScotlandsPeople] (accessed 19 April 2025), Mary Glasgow born or baptised on 20 Mar 1790, daughter of Robert Glasgow & Elizabeth Jack, in Barony, Lanarkshire, Scotland; citing Parish Number 622, Ref 30/255.</ref>
